notes.title: Version 0.2.14 Update
notes.notes:
0.2.14 update (Full House)
Full house is here!  All eight chefs are now in the game for playtesting!  Other major highlights in this build include a first version of the new ability tree system and all 24 C level support conversations!  Support convos will take a front seat in the next update.

Patch notes:

 Pele, Ku, and Ana are unlocked when you load from a save file that has completed the last tutorial ("Quick Mix").  They will eventually have their own quest chains and stories to unlock them.
 Artful Acrobatics, Rainbow Sampler, and Kitchen Booster Sync Styles are unlocked along with these chefs
 Sync Style choices have been moved to the staff tab of the customizer
 Aloha Spirit will no longer be picked by default when you try a new kitchen for the first time.  You will have to pick a style!
 Ability trees can be found under the "Staff" section of the customizer in place of the old ability system
 Old learned skills have been ignored for now (I have them in the save data, but haven't refunded books yet, sorry D:) Books can be gifted to fill Ability Book slots
 Lots of new abilities have been added
 C level supports have been added for all compatible characters

notes.title: 'Island Exploration' playtest update now live!
notes.notes:
Island Exploration is live for playtesting!

This update focused on delivering you more game content in the form of quests, recipes, and kitchens.  Go beach (kitchen)!  Have fun!

Old save files should be compatible.  If you would like to back up your save data from steam, Kitchen Sync saves are located in My Documents/My Games/IZ by default.  Hang on to copies of save.iz - that's the file the game uses for saves!  In future build, will support save swapping from within the game.

As usual we'd love to hear from you!   Join us and share any bugs, issues, or other feedback on Discord.  Or if you liked something, we'd like to hear that too ( ；∀；)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43918691/c14e5d0a7821dc47555e324c32a15b133e723cf4.png

Island Exploration Patch Notes

Chapter 2 of Kitchen:Sync Aloha! Is now fully playable in the playtest build:
	- A story chain of 6 new Mains
	- 8 new Sides
	- 6 new popups (one available during ch 1, five for ch 2)
	- New station: Seafood Station
	- 6 New recipes (14 total now)
	- New special twists for existing recipes with new station
	- Lono's unlock quest line has been fully implemented
	- New Theme song - jam out on the title screen ((d[-_-]b))

Gameplay changes
	- Reaching Hoku levels now levels up your kitchen to help you take on the next chapter of content.  Hoku 2 gives increased max cook level, increased XP gain, increased starting quality of dishes, and more
	- Pop-ups have some number of "locked stations" that can't be changed.  This should help encourage reasons to use different recipes and strategies.
	- New pop-ups and kitchens will start empty.  New Helper UI should assist in getting the menu and stations set up!
	- Gift rewards have been rebalanced, hopefully making the shops less obsolete and making open service more enticing
	- Challenge mode now available after reaching max rep at a pop-up.  Serve as many dishes as you can in the time limit to get bundles of gifts and Inspiration
	- Rep requirements for some CH 1 quests reduced or made "global rep"
	- Some story streamlining
	- A new kitchen is available!  For cash.
	

QoL/Bugs
	- The default mode of play at a location is set to do the next doable quest now instead of defaulting to open service
	- Better UI feedback in some areas - continued work expected in this area!
	- A bug preventing MC support progression has been solve
	- Loading screens should hopefully be a little quicker as game checkpoints are now done parallel to gameplay. Still investigating other possible causes of bloat
	- Lots of other bugs squashed

notes.title: KS:A! Roadmap Update
notes.notes:
With Teamwork/Dreamwork launched, we're on to the next milestone, and that means a roadmap update!  Next up is "Island Exploration", an update focused on content.  There are a lot of game systems and I want to make sure there's enough variety of foods, faces, and places to keep things fresh.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43918691/5bb3137bd6a16ca680012055f77990f0d7565c8b.png


Development is already underway, and new locations are springing up all over the Island.  The locations have some setting variety but another beach seemed overdue.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43918691/137907fab498b761a115c6ca1e6c17092dfb22a6.png


Meanwhile other cities are also interested in hosting your restaurant along the East coast.  This layout comes with a new customization point, the "Combo Counter" - this counts as either a Burner or an open counter so place what ever you want there!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43918691/cbc575859ea271efad28e292efc7b4ce91ac7529.png

Last but not least, get ready to Twist a whole new way as a new station arrives.  Looks a little fishy!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43918691/293b46273dc74cf4ac82df26ed1892ef2c7694e4.png

That's just a taste of the update for now, but we can't wait to get Island Exploration into your hands at the end of the month with all new kitchens and recipes to discover and master!

notes.title: Teamwork/Dreamwork Update Now Live
notes.notes:
Patch 0.2.9
Teamwork/Dreamwork is now live.  Customize your cooks and watch them bond and grow!
New features:

Abilities:
Characters can now learn abilities from ability books.
Ability books can be earned as rewards.  Different locations drop different books.
The School can now be unlocked from the Side "Back to School" after reaching Rep 5 in the Restaurant.  Similar to the shop this has one random lesson a day, though you can purchase multiple copies.

Lono:
The new character, Lono can be unlocked by finishing "Lono Preview", a placeholder Side.  First complete the side "In Search of Fresher Greens" to unlock the new map location.
Lono comes with a new sync style "Market Fresh"

Support:
Finishing a day increases the support level between your cooks.  Hitting certain values unlocks support events you can view from the map.
Support level is currently capped at "C"

Demo/tutorial:
The demo from Summer con is now in the build proper for those looking for a quick snack rather than the full buffet.
The tutorial missions

UI:
The prediction UI now appears to show estimated completion time, crit chance, and predicted quality when you hover a dish or cook over a location
Started implementing on hover effects in the kitchen. More to come.
"?"s now show up when a cook is idle and time unpauses
The mission selector on the map now is more clear which item is highlighted

Balance and Other Changes:
Dishes gain "Resistance" the more quality they have.  Resistance slows down progress and lowers crit rate.  The better the food the harder it is to make improvements!  Should help with scaling out balance as the game gets longer.
Special Twists now give a 20% quality bonus, up from 10% for all other twists.
Pot of Gold base quality increased to reflect difficulty of maximizing it's potential.
Fresh tickets have a chance to order "Chef's Choice" which is any dish you want.  Should help smooth out your flow!
Time limits have universally gone up to account for balance changes and be more friendly to newer players.  These will tighten up and get more difficult over time!
VIP missions (the ones where you serve one awesome dish) have been made a bit easier.
Fixed a bug preventing more than one tough customer per mission
Bunch of little changes and bug fixes.

As usual please let us know if you find any issues or have any feedback on our Discord https://discord.gg/CjJV5eFqn7!

notes.title: Playtest I Update
notes.notes:
Handful of bugfixes and improvements implemented with early tester feedback.  Playtesting doing it's job, thanks to the community :D

c:
-Jagged edges fixed on the nonspeaking characters in dialogue
-All blanks or no characters no longer accepted for character names (will return to default names)
-Hix box for tickets adjusted (incidentally this cleaned up dragger code at large so might be a slight perf boost on low end devices)
-Trashcan in first tutorial now glued shut
-Serving early in tutorial now properly blocked
-Continue without saving button has been removed for now, someday will have more sophisticated save slots n stuff
-Added autofitting text size to a few textboxes and labels
-Added a pokey hand anim to be more different than the grab hand for clarity for clicking vs dragging
-Unlocked sync skills now save and load properly
-"Use Sync Skill" bonus mission fixed, now can be won
-Some MC specific objectives weren't working with Kala as the chosen MC, should have fixed several cases
-Fixed a tutorial bug where the bark emoji was getting stuck
-Retry day now properly works on day 2 and is properly blocked on day 1
-Tutorial can survive character/dish placements of any order
-Colored text added to dialogue (general tag overhaul will help in future too)

d:
Fullscreen food now sparkles and steams. Ooooooo!
Sync bar now erupts in particles and noise when ready to go
Some small dialogue tweaks
New title screen!
Quality is now rounded to hint indicator values when calculating hp damage
New shop marker on map
